requirement: Implement policies and procedures to ensure appropriate access to ePHI
Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI
Implement a mechanism to encrypt ePHI whenever deemed appropriate
Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems
Implement mechanisms that record and examine activity in ePHI systems
Implement policies to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction
Establish procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of ePHI
Implement policies to authorize access to ePHI
Procedures for creating changing and safeguarding passwords/credentials
Verify person or entity accessing ePHI is who claimed
